items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: But anyway, sometimes I used to play bass with them, too.

ctx.x: Well, he, he played with that, it wasn't such a big band, it was just about three or four pieces, or five pieces, I think it was Walter Preston, Tom Brown, uh, Charlie Washington, and, uh, let's see, what's that guy named, uh, I can't think of the bass player. But anyway, sometimes I used to play bass with them, too. And they used to go out, they used to play out at the halfway house, though. They had a, a place on that side of the halfway house, you could go in and play music. And then from there they'd go out…
Was Charlie Washington any kind of Lonzo Washington?
